required_direct_chain: decision provenance separating ownership from enforcement
newly decided policy returned into subsequent operation
matched native-or-adapter-preserved canonical harness comparison for primary-baseline use

reviewed_route_classes.blocking_reason: These evaluate operation, enforcement or propagation under pre-existing policy rather than legitimate ultimate authority making and returning a new organizational policy decision.
The evaluated system reasons about values or external policy but is not established as the legitimate ultimate authority of its own organization.
Actual ratification/amendment processes exist, but they are governance records/protocols rather than reusable agent-harness capability benchmarks.
The protocol can support parent-governed S5 but supplies no harness capability result.
First-party tests exercise legitimate amendment mechanisms and authority guards, but the artifact is a conformance/regression suite rather than a reusable matched harness benchmark.
Policy adaptation is measurable, but the evaluated system is not established as the legitimate ultimate organizational authority resolving an identity-level tension.

closure_claim: Current public evidence contains strong S5-shaped mechanisms, governance processes and proxies, but no reusable direct benchmark family that exercises legitimate ultimate authority through policy decision/change and subsequent operation, and no canonical direct S5 observation.
reopen_when: a public benchmark exercises identity or ultimate-policy conflict through legitimate authority, actual decision or amendment, and subsequent operation under the newly decided policy
a canonical S5 system publishes an immutable native or adapter-preserved direct result satisfying the full S5 chain
a materially matched benchmark compares two or more canonical-linkable S5 systems under the same authority/change/subsequent-operation protocol
do_not_reopen_for: fixed-policy adherence, filtering or enforcement benchmarks
external public-policy analysis or value-expression tasks
governance mechanism unit tests, protocols or live constitutional history without a reusable harness capability benchmark
non_claim: This closure is not a zero S5 capability score and does not deny that canonical systems own S5. It freezes the reviewed public-evidence state until a direct reusable S5 capability benchmark or canonical native result appears.
